tool_args.rationale: Fit the recalled coupled two-state memory ODE to all eight paid rows, deriving each initial memory state from the raw irregular history when no precomputed convolution is supplied. RK4 integration predicts x(H), the observed target y.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The fine trajectory batch raised the dataset to eight rows, satisfying the recalled four-parameter ODE identifiability requirement.
History-gap and transient-lag signatures, along with varied endpoint-matched histories, favor the coupled memory ODE.
The observations are consistent with a stationary smooth coupled ODE; no chaotic sign-oscillation signature or refuting confirmation is reported.
